goal: Iterate until both creation benchmarks meet the targets; a failed experiment changes the next experiment, not the goal.

protocol.answer: One Devanagari form for finite or krdanta creation. Multi-form paradigm/contrast pilots use a separate strict JSON metric and are not certified benchmark designs.

iterations.experiment: Unprefixed primary conjugation, 6000 Opus High tasks
iterations.finding: 95.83% overall; searched grammatical filters insufficient under original quotas

iterations.experiment: Eight derived-root constructions, 50 random development cases each; zero or one prefix; both models xHigh
iterations.finding: Astra 314/400 (78.5%), 314/392 completed (80.1%). Opus 123/400 with 262 classifier refusals; 123/138 completed (89.1%). Raw Opus score does not establish difficulty.

iterations.experiment: 480 fresh tasks across six compositions using established prompt plus grammatical fields
iterations.reason: Original pilot had 262/400 Opus classifier refusals. Shortened prompt completed 2/32, established-template extension completed 31/32 (28 correct). Prompt probes are not difficulty calibration.
iterations.finding: Astra 362/480 (75.4%), 362/457 completed (79.2%). Opus 394/480 (82.1%), 394/466 completed (84.5%). Broad mixtures miss both targets.

iterations.experiment: 200 fresh interaction tasks: 100 intensive-causative aorists with audited scope exclusions, 100 triple derivatives in three tenses
iterations.reason: Test low-accuracy leads with more families and exclude unresolved oracle behavior.
iterations.finding: Opus: aorists45/100 overall,45/96 completed; triple62/100,62/95 completed. Astra: aorists64/100,64/85 completed (75.3%); triple48/100,48/90 completed (53.3%). Astra has25 total truncations. Neither is final certification; later calibration excludes7.4.95.

iterations.experiment: 200 fresh intensive-causative aorists: specified ending set crossed with one/two prefixes
iterations.reason: Opus 45/100 has a 53.2% one-sided upper confidence limit. Test greater compositional difficulty while Astra processes earlier pilots.
iterations.finding: 16/200 tasks contain malformed abhi rather than SLP1 aBi. On 184 valid inputs, Opus is 92/184 (50%). Raw 46% is withdrawn as grammar evidence. See the prefix input audit.

iterations.experiment: Fresh calibration: 300 mixed-composition tasks and 500 Parasmaipada intensive-causative aorists
iterations.reason: Validate Opus difficulty margins and estimate root-cluster variation on new tasks while the paired Astra pilots remain live. Rule 7.4.95 excluded pending homonym scope review. The candidate tiers are not final benchmark membership.
iterations.finding: Bench: 182/300 (60.7%), 182/283 completed (64.3%). Hard: 61/500 invalid prefix inputs excluded; valid 216/439 (49.2%), 216/410 completed (52.7%). Valid two-prefix subset: 77/189 (40.7%), 77/171 completed (45.0%). Fresh calibration needed. Astra pairing of the valid 300-task Bench panel is now submitted.

iterations.experiment: 500 fresh two-prefix aorists, 125 each for sam+pra, pra+ni, upa+ni and canonical aBi+sam
iterations.reason: The remaining valid two-prefix tasks scored 77/189 overall and 77/171 when completed. Calibrate on new cases after repairing prefix validation; no final test calls.
iterations.finding: Corrected inputs: Opus 252/500 (50.4%), 252/445 completed (56.6%); each prefix cell is 55–60% among completed. Hard target missed. Do not freeze this recipe.

iterations.experiment: 200 fresh tasks with 3–6 alternating causative/desiderative operations, in three non-aorist tenses
iterations.reason: The corrected two-prefix aorist recipe is too easy on Opus. Test greater derivational depth while keeping one Devanagari answer. Formal grammar review excludes direct san+san and distinguishes rule-based licensing from attestation.
iterations.finding: Opus 120/200 (60.0%), 120/193 completed (62.2%). Hard target missed overall. Four-operation chain 25/50; six-operation chain 29/50: depth is not monotonically harder.

iterations.experiment: 160 fresh small-paradigm creation tasks: 80 with two forms and 80 with four forms of the same derived root.
iterations.reason: Test consistent inflection across tenses after one-form recipes missed Hard. This changes task granularity; report all-forms and per-form metrics separately. Inspired by SIGMORPHON paradigm evaluation, not a claim of full-paradigm coverage.
iterations.finding: Opus 74/160 raw (46.25%), but 47 refusals. Completed accuracy: 37/59 two-form (62.7%), 37/54 four-form (68.5%). Almost all form errors co-occur. Hard not established; do not freeze.

iterations.experiment: 300 fresh one-form benedictives: 100 each with four, five or six reviewed operations, all with two canonical prefixes.
iterations.reason: Replicate the small AshirLin leads (7/18, 5/11, 7/15) before any final choice. One-form scope, same v4 prompt, no aorist. Opus first to avoid paying Astra for a recipe that fails on Opus.
iterations.finding: Opus 165/300 (55.0%), 165/265 completed (62.3%); cells 52/100, 56/100, 57/100. Hard missed; no Astra pairing needed for this failed recipe.

iterations.experiment: 120 fresh contrast sets: 60 two-row and 60 four-row tasks with different derived stems of one root.
iterations.reason: The 300-task deeper benedictive calibration failed Hard, while same-stem paradigm errors were nearly perfectly correlated. Contrast different transformations with a common root, person, number and prefixes. Report per-form and all-correct task accuracy; Opus first.
iterations.finding: Not a valid Hard result. 93/120 refusals dominate the raw13.3% score; only27 completed. Two-row9/19=47.4%, four-row7/8=87.5%; survivor subsets are too small and selected by refusal to establish unbiased grammatical difficulty. Do not submit this prompt to Astra just to pursue the raw threshold.

iterations.experiment: 320 fresh inflected verbal derivatives: eight construction/suffix cells,40 tasks each. One Devanagari answer.
iterations.reason: Finite and multi-form routes have not established Hard. Add nominal inflection after reviewed derived stems using Satf/tfc/ktavatu. Six independent reference examples match VP. Satf is restricted to cases2–7; all cells exclude Curadi.
iterations.finding: Opus235/320 (73.4%),235/312 usable completed answers (75.3%),7 refusals,1 duplicate-answer response,no truncations. Hardest cell Ric->san->Ric->san+Satf is22/40 (55%). Broad nominal recipe rejected; no Astra spending on it.

iterations.experiment: Reevaluate every task in the120 contrast and160 paradigm panels with explicit Sanskrit verbal root (dhatu) wording.
iterations.reason: User noted root/computer-user ambiguity. Inspection found unqualified root in both new multi-form prompts. Preserve old versions; restore the established Sanskrit introduction and grammatical glosses without changing tasks, gold, or scoring.
iterations.selection: All prior items, independent of previous correctness or refusal. These repeated exposures do not add unique task N.
iterations.finding: Explicit Sanskrit context: contrast19/120,86 refusals,33 usable completed; paradigm41/160,93 refusals,67 completed. Wording treatment did not restore dependable completion.

iterations.experiment: Replace only Sanskrit verbal root with Sanskrit verbal base on32 fixed tasks per multi-form format.
iterations.finding: Contrast8/32,20 refusals;paradigm4/32,22 refusals. Removing root did not resolve the behavior. Same sampled questions, no new unique task N.

iterations.experiment: Same64 questions with one Devanagari form per line instead of JSON.
iterations.reason: Separate output-format effects from the root-word hypothesis. Preserve every grammatical question and require all forms correct.
iterations.finding: 61/64 refusals; ordered lines alone did not restore completion.

iterations.experiment: Minimal extension of established single-form grammar template on the same64questions.
iterations.finding: 57usable completed;32correct;5refusals2truncations. Prompt format usable for fresh calibration, but this small repeated sample does not establish Hard.

iterations.experiment: One-word creation of a dvandva from two/four independently derived participles.
iterations.finding: Original64:62refusals. Compact field32:31refusals,1completed incorrect. No Astra request;not usable grammatical difficulty.
iterations.validity: Four elementary independent compound controls pass;191/192 member stems agree across engine versions. aga~|Bhvadi length disagreement remains unresolved and is excluded from future panels.

iterations.experiment: 64 independent-creation sets:32two-form and32four-form,192new components and distinct development dhatu families.
iterations.rationale: Test joint creation across different dhatus while reporting per-form accuracy; avoid perfect error correlation on shared stems.
iterations.selection: Fresh components with conservative grammatical exclusions, no response-based item selection.
iterations.finding: Two-form 16/22 completed correct; four-form 12/17. 22 refusals and 3 truncations. Astra was prepared but not submitted.

iterations.experiment: 64 documented unadi nominal-stem creations; one word per answer.
iterations.finding: 31/64 correct; 30 refusals; 31/34 completed correct. Source consistency checked on 236 cases; 221 matched, 15 excluded before model calls. No claim of scalable difficulty.

iterations.experiment: 32 unadi and 32 independent-creation questions rendered entirely in Sanskrit.
iterations.reason: Test language-context effects on benign-task classifier refusals. Same preselected questions and deterministic scoring; no extra unique task N.
iterations.finding: Uṇādi:27/32 correct,all32 completed. Finite sets:25/32 correct,29 completed,3 truncated. No refusals. Language and Batch/direct transport both changed, so causality is not isolated. Repeated tasks add zero unique N.

iterations.experiment: 64 one-form passive creations, crossing two existing derived-stem chains with present-system and non-present tenses.
iterations.reason: Expand the original finite Cartesian space along voice rather than merely increasing output count.
iterations.validity: Four independent elementary controls;full regeneration;no aorist/Bhave/Curadi and conservative exclusions for open rules.

adaptive_loop: Generate and audit candidate constructions locally.
Run small comparable pilots on both providers. Inspect errors for actual grammar, valid alternatives, refusals and truncations.
If too easy, change grammatical composition or task design and repeat. Do not exhaust the same sampling scheme.
Calibrate promising mixtures on fresh development tasks; target at most 60% / 40% to leave margin.
Freeze grammatical predicates, weights, seed, task membership and scoring before reserved-family evaluation.
Release 1000 per tier if verified; minimum 500. If a target fails, preserve and report that version, then design a new version with fresh reserved data.
revised_design_choices: The first plan’s per-tense quotas and 50-family minimum for each tiny construction are not requirements. Use overall diversity and measure uncertainty.
Up to four tasks per root family; target at least 250 distinct families per 1000-task tier, preferably more. Keep task IDs disjoint; use the existing root-family test/train split.
Reserve half the test families for a later version until the first release attempt is frozen.
No item selected because the final model missed it. Development results may select constructions and mixtures, with chronology disclosed.
No claim that any finite dataset is unsaturable; publish a versioned generator and separate RL split for renewable tasks.

The one-form output restriction was an initial design choice, not a user requirement. A new two/four-form creation pilot tests paradigm consistency. A paradigm counts as one task; publish per-form accuracy alongside exact task accuracy.
validity: Explicit sanadi order and prefixes; classical active only in initial pilot; no Bhave.
All accepted VP variants, deterministic regeneration and transliteration checks.
Check linguistic conditions, source regression examples and adjudicate systematic mismatches before release. VP agreement alone is not independent grammatical certification.

Require reviewed SLP1 upasarga spellings. The abhi/aBi input bug was found and all affected tasks are excluded by lexical validity, with raw runs preserved. Engine generation alone does not validate lexical inputs.
precision: 1000 tasks does not guarantee SE <1pp. Report root-cluster bootstrap SE and confidence intervals; decide whether additional independent tasks are affordable after discovery. Repeated completions do not increase unique N.
selection_rationale: Explain the underlying composition and the empirical development evidence. The rationale is post hoc to discovery but fixed before the final held-out evaluations.
precision_followup: After measuring accuracy and family-cluster variance, consider expanding above 1000 unique tasks if needed for SE <1pp and affordable. Size 1000 is a preference, not proof of the precision target.
